$comment: R968 audit scope from the TRUSTED running checkout, never the candidate diff. mode: open | invariants. Standard default: open (OFF). Missing, invalid or unreadable tool mode leaves platform auditScope in effect, then standard open if platform is silent. Policy cascade: standard, platform auditScope, this tool file. The environment is NOT a source: an env var must never loosen a gate. Invariants mode requires a usable --invariants-file; otherwise warn and use open review. In invariants mode out-of-scope FOLLOW-UP findings are demoted to nonblocking, but every one is recorded verbatim in the ledger record's demoted list and printed, and the verdict line reads `NOT WEAKENED (scoped; N demoted)`. Provenance uses the shared policy-cascade logging convention.
